old_value: {"id":"fedistract-xzkb.34","title":"fedi-e2ee missing zeroize on key intermediates","description":"ed25519_to_x25519_private() at fedi-e2ee/src/lib.rs:186-192 does not zeroize two intermediates containing key material: (1) the SHA-512 hash output (GenericArray\u003cu8, U64\u003e) which contains the full Ed25519 expanded key, and (2) the x_bytes [u8; 32] array copied from hash[..32].
